parkinsons.title: Parkinson's Disease Home Screening
parkinsons.subtitle: Advanced Telemetry Screening
parkinsons.description: Using advanced smartphone sensor logic, this module approximates key motor and vocal biomarkers related to Parkinson's disease. The test runs completely in your web browser and takes approximately 2 minutes to complete. It measures tremor stability, finger-tapping speed (motor control), and voice frequency stability.
parkinsons.introText: This browser-sensor check consists of 3 small tests taking 15s, 15s, and 12s respectively.
parkinsons.rule1: You are sitting comfortably in a quiet, distraction-free room.
parkinsons.rule2: If on a smartphone, prepare to grant microphone and motion sensor access.
parkinsons.rule3: If on a desktop, the sensor test will execute in simulated calibration mode.
parkinsons.step1Text: Measure muscle stabilization at rest. If on mobile, place the device in the palm of your dominant hand, rest your arm flat on a table, and hold still.
parkinsons.holdStillDesc: Hold your device completely still. Analyzing motion telemetry...
parkinsons.step2Text: Assess motor coordination. Tap the LEFT and RIGHT buttons alternately as fast and consistently as possible using your index finger.
parkinsons.alternateTappingDesc: Alternate tapping left and right as quickly as possible.
parkinsons.step3Text: Analyze voice pitch stability (checking for micro-tremors or monotony). Prepare to speak the phrase below clearly and in a steady voice.
parkinsons.targetPhraseText: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
parkinsons.processingDesc: Compiling accelerometer telemetry, motor intervals, and voice pitch signals. Processing with SVM classification engine...
parkinsons.label: SVM Classification
parkinsons.highRiskRec: The screening detected telemetry patterns consistent with elevated motor/acoustic changes. We strongly recommend scheduling an appointment with a neurologist for a comprehensive assessment.
parkinsons.modRiskRec: Mild changes in motor coordination or voice pitch stability were detected. We recommend logging your daily symptoms and discussing these results with a doctor.
parkinsons.lowRiskRec: All telemetry indicators are within the healthy baseline reference range. No significant Parkinsonian markers detected. Maintain a healthy lifestyle and re-screen in 3 months.
